about.metaDescription: Learn about AmTrans — your trusted partner for international parcel transportation. Discover our mission, values, and commitment to reliable, transparent delivery.

hero.title: Connecting the World,
hero.subtitle: AmTrans is a fully licensed leader in air cargo freight, built on over a decade of proven expertise, complete transparency, and legal compliance. We deliver ultra-fast express shipping from Armenia to Russia (Moscow, St. Petersburg, and other cities), from Moscow to Armenia, and from Dubai to Armenia—handling every parcel with the highest standard of care and guaranteed professionalism.

mission.title: Built for the Modern
mission.subtitle: AmTrans was created with one clear purpose: to take the complexity out of international parcel delivery and give every person and business a reliable, honest transportation partner they can count on.
mission.p1: Sending parcels across borders has always come with uncertainty — delays, opaque pricing, and little communication. AmTrans was built to fix exactly that. We serve customers who need a straightforward, dependable way to ship packages internationally without the guesswork.
mission.p2: Our platform lets you register your parcel, track its journey in real time, and stay informed every step of the way. From the moment you drop off your package to the moment it reaches its destination, you have full visibility and a support team ready to help.
mission.p3: We believe transparency is not a feature — it's the foundation. That's why our pricing is clear, our tracking is honest, and our communication is timely. No hidden fees. No surprises.
mission.quote: "We don't just move parcels — we carry trust."

values.transparencyDesc: Clear pricing, real-time parcel status, and no hidden charges — ever.
values.reliabilityDesc: Consistent, professional handling from pickup to final delivery.
values.convenienceDesc: Register, track, and manage shipments online — no paperwork, no queues.
values.customerFirstDesc: Every decision we make is guided by what's best for the people we serve.

privacy.metaDescription: Learn how AmTrans collects, uses, protects, and handles your personal information, cargo details, and shipment data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At AmTrans Express Logistics ("AmTrans", "we", "us", or "our"), we value your trust and are fully committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy details how we collect, process, store, and safeguard your information across our website, logistics platform, customer support systems, and international shipping services.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.subtitle: Categories of personal, shipment, and technical data processed during your use of AmTrans services.
section1.personalIdDesc: Full legal name, national identity document or passport details, and taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) required by customs authorities for cross-border freight compliance.
section1.contactDesc: Primary email address, verified telephone and mobile numbers, billing addresses, and designated recipient delivery addresses.
section1.cargoDesc: Parcel dimensions, weight measurements, item descriptions, declared merchandise value, commercial invoices, and unique tracking numbers.
section1.supportDesc: Real-time communication transcripts, inquiry history, uploaded attachments, and feedback submitted via our 1:1 support chat or customer service channels.
section1.technicalDesc: IP address, browser type, device identifiers, operating system version, and session timestamps used to maintain platform stability and detect unauthorized access.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.subtitle: Legitimate operational and legal purposes for which your data is processed.
section2.purpose1Desc: To register parcel transfers, coordinate international air and overland transit, sort packages at transit hubs, and execute final delivery to destination branch offices or recipient addresses.
section2.purpose2Desc: To compile accurate customs declarations, determine applicable import taxes or duties, and comply with state and international trade statutes.
section2.purpose3Desc: To send automated tracking updates, delivery milestones, warehouse arrival alerts, and customs status notifications via SMS, email, or your platform dashboard.
section2.purpose4Desc: To verify receiver identities upon parcel release, safeguard customer account credentials, and protect our logistics network against illicit cargo.

section3.title: 3. Data Sharing & Third Parties
section3.subtitle: Strictly limited disclosure protocols essential for international logistics operations.
section3.noSaleNotice: Strict Guarantee: AmTrans does not sell, rent, monetize, or trade your personal data to any third-party advertisers or data brokers under any circumstances.
section3.customsDesc: Mandatory transfer of shipment documentation and recipient details to state customs authorities and border control agencies strictly as required by law.
section3.logisticsDesc: Trusted partner carriers, airport cargo terminals, and licensed regional courier drivers strictly to the extent required to physically transport and deliver your parcels.
section3.legalDesc: Government agencies, law enforcement, or judicial authorities only when legally compelled by court orders, search warrants, or binding statutory regulations.

section4.title: 4. Data Security & Retention
section4.subtitle: Industry-grade protection protocols and retention schedules.
section4.securityDesc: All data in transit is protected using modern SSL/TLS encryption. Sensitive databases are secured behind role-based access barriers, automated audit trails, and salted password hashing.
section4.retentionDesc: Customs declarations and cargo manifests are retained in accordance with statutory accounting and tax retention periods. Active user account records remain stored until an account closure request is processed.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights & Data Controls
section5.subtitle: Clear mechanisms to access, amend, or remove your personal information.
section5.right1Desc: You can view your complete order history, recipient address book, and profile records at any time within your AmTrans dashboard.
section5.right2Desc: You may update or correct inaccurate profile details, recipient phone numbers, or delivery addresses directly in your account settings.
section5.right3Desc: You may request the deletion of your personal account and associated records, subject to ongoing statutory customs and tax retention mandates.

section6.title: 6. Updates to This Policy
section6.subtitle: Keeping you informed of operational and regulatory adjustments.
section6.desc: AmTrans periodically revises this Privacy Policy to reflect changing logistics regulations, technology improvements, or service enhancements. When material updates are made, we will update the "Effective Date" at the top of this document and notify active users via email or on-platform notifications.

section7.title: 7. Contact Us & Privacy Support
section7.subtitle: Direct channels to connect with our compliance and customer care teams.
section7.desc: If you have questions, feedback, or wish to exercise your data privacy rights, please reach out to us using any of the following channels:
section7.chatDesc: Connect with an AmTrans operator in real-time for immediate answers to shipment and privacy inquiries.

By registering an account, submitting an order, or utilizing our international logistics and cargo transfer services, you agree to be fully bound by these terms.

terms.itemsText: Mandatory compliance guide for UAE and EAEU international transit corridors.

section1.title: 1. General Terms & Service Scope
section1.subtitle: Definition of logistics services provided by AmTrans.
section1.p1: AmTrans operates an integrated logistics, transfer, and freight management platform facilitating air, land, and multimodal parcel transportation between the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) member states (so far, the Republic of Armenia and the Russian Federation), and international transit corridors.
section1.p2: Services encompass parcel reception at origin logistics centers, international sorting, export customs declaration, line-haul carriage, destination clearance, and handover via authorized branch pickup or regional door-to-door delivery.

section2.title: 2. User Responsibilities & Documentation
section2.subtitle: Mandatory accuracy requirements for sender and recipient information.
section2.p1: The User guarantees that all personal and logistical information submitted—including sender identity, recipient full legal name, passport/ID numbers, tax identification codes (TIN), delivery addresses, package contents, and declared customs values—is authentic, complete, and legally verifiable.
section2.p2: Any discrepancy, intentional misdeclaration, or omission of cargo specifications constitutes a material breach of these terms, rendering the User strictly liable for all associated administrative penalties, fines, customs impoundments, and legal expenses incurred by AmTrans or state regulatory bodies.

section3.title: 3. Prohibited Items: United Arab Emirates (UAE)
section3.subtitle: Strictly forbidden items under UAE federal customs laws and aviation safety mandates.
section3.warning: Absolute Prohibition: The following categories are strictly barred from import, export, or transit through UAE territories. Attempting to ship these items will result in immediate confiscation and referral to UAE law enforcement.
section3.cat1Desc: Cocaine, heroin, hashish, cannabis/marijuana derivatives, all poppy plant species and seeds, mace, and any synthetic psychotropic formulations.
section3.cat2Desc: All electronic cigarettes, vape devices, e-shisha units, heated tobacco devices, loose tobacco, and uncertified tobacco preparations.
section3.cat3Desc: Cyanides, heavy metals (cadmium, mercury, arsenic), asbestos, and Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) harmful to public health and the environment.
section3.cat4Desc: Industrial pesticides, chemical fertilizers, herbicides, and non-certified fungicides banned by environmental protection authorities.
section3.cat5Desc: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs), hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs), and all ozone-layer depleting gases.
section3.cat6Desc: All categories of used or retreaded pneumatic tires, including passenger vehicle, aircraft, heavy machinery, and forklift tires.

section4.title: 4. Prohibited Items: EAEU Member States
section4.subtitle: Articles prohibited under the Eurasian Economic Commission Customs Union Code.
section4.warning: EAEU Customs Union Regulation: The following items are prohibited from international parcel shipping across the territories of Armenia, Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan.
section4.cat1Desc: Firearms, hunting rifles, military equipment, blades exceeding 90mm in length, paralyzing electroshock devices, pepper sprays, tear gases, explosives, detonators, and radioactive or nuclear compounds.
section4.cat2Desc: All types of drones, quadcopters, and remote-controlled aircraft with camera or autonomous flight capabilities.
section4.cat3Desc: Narcotic substances, psychotropics, uncertified potent pharmaceuticals, medical poisons, and hazardous chemical precursors.
section4.cat4Desc: All alcoholic drinks, beers, spirits, cigarettes, cigars, vape liquids, and nicotine-containing cartridges.
section4.cat5Desc: Raw or unprocessed meats, fresh fish, poultry, incubation eggs, untreated animal feeds, and temperature-sensitive food items.
section4.cat6Desc: Live animals, insects, plants, untreated animal hides, down/feathers from restricted territories (IT/CH), and silkworm cocoons.
section4.cat7Desc: Precious metals (gold, platinum), gemstones, cultural heritage treasures, national museum items, state medals, and cash currencies subject to central bank restrictions.
section4.cat8Desc: Hazardous industrial scrap, natural soils, Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs), toxic slag, and chemical residues.
section4.cat9Desc: Printed materials, films, photography, or digital media containing extremist propaganda, hate speech, or materials damaging public morality.

section5.title: 5. Restricted Items: EAEU (Special Permits Required)
section5.subtitle: Goods permitted for international transfer ONLY with official certificates and state permits.
section5.notice: Conditional Carriage: The items below may only be shipped when accompanied by authentic, validated regulatory certificates uploaded and pre-approved prior to dispatch.
section5.res1Desc: Processed commercial packaged food, plant seeds, agricultural raw materials, and dried herbal products.
section5.res2Desc: Bulk cosmetic formulations, medicinal hygiene articles, specialized skincare, and items produced using GMO derivatives.
section5.res3Req: Mandatory Ministry of Health Permits & Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
section5.res3Desc: Diagnostic chemical reagents, medical isotope distillates, and specialized hospital preparations.
section5.res4Req: Declared Insured Carriage & Official Export/Import License
section5.res4Desc: Collectible bank notes, commemorative coins, philately items, and non-weapon tactical gear/uniforms.

section6.title: 6. Customs Inspection, Confiscation & Liability
section6.subtitle: Legal authority of AmTrans and regulatory agencies.
section6.inspectDesc: AmTrans reserves the unconditional right to inspect, X-ray scan, and open any consignment at any stage of transit to verify compliance with national safety laws and carriage regulations.
section6.confiscateDesc: Discovered contraband, hazardous materials, or undeclared prohibited goods will be confiscated immediately and surrendered to state customs or police authorities. No shipping refunds or indemnification will be granted.
section6.liabilityDesc: AmTrans shall not be held liable for shipment delays, customs holds, confiscations, or storage penalties caused by user misdeclaration, failure to supply permits, or state border enforcement actions.

section7.title: 7. Amendments, Dispute Resolution & Support
section7.subtitle: Policy revisions, governing jurisdiction, and official assistance.
section7.amendDesc: AmTrans reserves the right to modify these Terms & Conditions as mandated by international trade regulations or operational requirements. Updated versions are binding upon publication on the platform.
section7.contactDesc: If you have inquiries regarding shipment feasibility, restricted classifications, or require compliance clearance, contact our support team:
section7.chatDesc: Chat in real-time with an AmTrans logistics specialist to verify if your items can be legally shipped.

ch1.title: Getting Started with AmTrans
ch1.subtitle: Registration, verification, and first dashboard access
ch1.description: Learn how to create your personal or corporate AmTrans account, verify your email address, and access your centralized logistics control panel.
ch1.step1Desc: Navigate to the registration page (/auth/register) and provide your email and a strong password.
ch1.step1Detail1: Email must be valid and accessible, as activation codes and cargo status updates are dispatched here.
ch1.step1Detail2: Password requires a minimum of 8 characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.
ch1.step2Desc: Immediately after submitting the form, AmTrans dispatches an activation link containing your secure cryptographic token:
ch1.step2Point1: Clicking the link activates your credentials in real time.
ch1.step2Point2: Directs you to profile completion for customs verification.
ch1.step3Desc: Once logged in, your dashboard displays your permanent 'User Code'.
ch1.step3Note: This code tells our international warehouse operators that incoming packages belong to your account.
ch1.tip1Content: Your verification token is tied directly to your user identity. AmTrans staff will never ask for your password or verification link.
ch1.tip2Content: Your User Code is your shipping identifier. When purchasing online, appending this code to the recipient name ensures automated parcel identification at overseas hubs.

ch2.title: Set Up Your Account & Profile
ch2.subtitle: Profiles, identification documents, and entity types
ch2.description: Provide accurate identification details required by international customs authorities and configure your notification channels.
ch2.sectionDesc: Customs legislation in the Republic of Armenia requires official identification for every international parcel. You can manage them anytime in Dashboard → Profile.
ch2.mockupTitle: Interactive Mockup • Switch Entity Type to Preview Fields
ch2.telegramTitle: Link Your Telegram Account for Instant Updates
ch2.telegramDesc: Never miss an update. When connected, our Telegram bot automatically notifies you the second your package arrives at the foreign warehouse, boards the flight, and is ready for pickup.
ch2.tip1Content: Ensure your First and Last Name match your passport or ID card exactly. Inconsistencies may lead to customs clearance delays in Armenia.
ch2.tip2Content: You can update your phone number and delivery address anytime in Dashboard → Profile.

ch3.title: Manage Addresses & Receivers
ch3.subtitle: Overseas warehouse addresses and authorized package recipients
ch3.description: Learn how to use AmTrans global warehouse hubs for online shopping and designate family members or colleagues to collect shipments.
ch3.title1: How to Use Overseas Hub Addresses
ch3.desc1: When ordering from international online stores (Amazon, Taobao, Noon, eBay), enter our warehouse address as the shipping destination. Always include your User Code so we can immediately match the incoming parcel to your account.
ch3.mockupTitle1: AmTrans UI Demonstration • Interactive Warehouse Card with One-Click Copy
ch3.desc2: In the Receivers section, you can register family members or colleagues who are authorized to collect parcels from AmTrans branches.
ch3.addReceiverDesc: Add multiple receivers to take advantage of individual customs duty allowances.
ch3.tip1Content: Under EAEU regulations, individual duty-free limits apply per recipient. Adding multiple family members as receivers helps manage duty thresholds legally for larger consumer purchases.
ch3.tip2Content: You can update receiver contact details or remove outdated receivers with one click in 'Receivers' page.

ch4.title: Register a Shipment
ch4.subtitle: Pre-alerts, product parameters, dimensions, and invoice uploads
ch4.description: Master the shipment registration workflow. Learn why pre-registering parcels before arrival at foreign warehouses speeds up processing.
ch4.ruleTitle: Register Shipments BEFORE They Reach the Foreign Warehouse
ch4.ruleDesc: As soon as an online store or supplier ships your order and issues a carrier tracking number, create the shipment in your AmTrans dashboard immediately. Pre-alerting guarantees automated barcode matching upon arrival, instant physical intake, and zero delay at customs checkpoints.
ch4.formDesc: Click '+ Register Shipment' on the Orders page to open the order registration modal. Below is an explanation of each field and the information required.
ch4.afterSubmitTitle: What Happens After You Click Submit?
ch4.step1CardDesc: Your order is entered into the central AmTrans manifest with its tracking code, awaiting merchant delivery.
ch4.step2CardDesc: When the carrier delivers the package, warehouse operators scan the barcode and re-weigh the item.
ch4.step3CardDesc: Your dashboard and Telegram alert you that the parcel is safely logged as FOREIGN_WAREHOUSE.
ch4.tip1Content: Always declare the exact purchase price shown on your invoice. Customs authorities randomly inspect shipments, and discrepancies can result in penalties or cargo detention.
ch4.tip2Content: Check the AmTrans Terms & Conditions page (/terms) before shipping. Flammable liquids, standalone lithium batteries, pressurized cans, and weapons are strictly prohibited on air cargo routes.

ch5.title: Understand Shipping Costs & Tariffs
ch5.subtitle: Tariffs, actual vs volumetric weight, 5kg minimum, and price estimates
ch5.description: Understand how shipping costs are calculated, the 5kg minimum billable weight policy, and how price quotes are handled on custom routes.
ch5.rule1Desc: Standard fixed price per kilogram based on the international corridor (e.g., UAE, USA, or China to Armenia).
ch5.rule2Desc: Charged on the higher of physical scale weight or volumetric space occupied.
ch5.rule3Desc: Math.max(weight, 5). Packages below 5kg are billed at the 5kg minimum tier.
ch5.rule4Desc: The booking tariff is permanently frozen for your order, guaranteeing zero unexpected price changes.
ch5.widgetDesc: Test how physical weight, dimensions, and the 5kg minimum threshold interact to generate the final transit fee.
ch5.noTariffBadge: Special & Custom Corridors • Price by Request
ch5.noTariffTitle: What Happens When a Route Has No Established Tariff?
ch5.noTariffDesc: Some non-standard routes require custom cargo quotes. In this case, your order is submitted with the status PENDING_ESTIMATE.
ch5.estimateExplanation: The customer receives an alert in /dashboard/orders with the operator's quote. You have full freedom to proceed or cancel:
ch5.tip1Content: Always keep the 5kg minimum in mind when ordering small, lightweight items. Consolidating multiple items into one shipment helps you get the maximum value from the 5kg bracket.
ch5.tip2Content: You can test routes, dimensions, and get instant shipping quotes anytime by clicking the Calculator icon in the top navigation header.

ch6.title: Track Your Shipment & Understand Statuses
ch6.subtitle: The 10-status lifecycle, progress timeline, and tracking numbers
ch6.description: Follow your parcel across every milestone from registration to local arrival with real-time status updates and transparent tracking.
ch6.desc1: Click any status to explore its exact meaning, operational milestone, and badge color styling used across the AmTrans platform.
ch6.visibilityNote: Visible to customer in: Orders Table, Mobile Order Card, and Details Screen.
ch6.emailDesc: Automated transactional emails notify you at key delivery milestones: when intake is confirmed abroad, when transit begins, and when your package is sorted into your local branch.
ch6.telegramDesc: For instantaneous mobile alerts, link your Telegram profile. Push notifications arrive within seconds of warehouse intake and flight arrivals.
ch6.tip1Title: Tracking Physical Arrival at Foreign Hubs
ch6.tip1Content: When the local courier (USPS, FedEx, DHL, SF Express) marks your parcel as "Delivered" to our warehouse, please allow up to 4-12 working hours for our intake staff to scan, weigh, and update the status to FOREIGN_WAREHOUSE.
ch6.tip2Content: Your AmTrans tracking code (e.g., AM78219-01) is used for all internal logistics, while your merchant tracking number is recorded for overseas carrier verification.

ch7.title: Receive Your Package & Pickup QR Code
ch7.subtitle: Ready status, instant QR verification, office locations, and support
ch7.description: Learn how to collect your package quickly and smoothly using your digital QR verification pass at AmTrans local offices.
ch7.badge1: Fast Branch Pickup • Digital QR Pass
ch7.title1: Paperless Handover with Instant QR Code
ch7.desc1: Once your order status changes to READY, open it in your dashboard. Present your QR code and passport to a branch staff member to collect your order.
ch7.mockupTitle: AmTrans UI Demonstration • Digital Pickup QR Pass
ch7.supportDesc: Have questions regarding package condition, customs fees, or delivery? Chat directly with AmTrans operators via your customer dashboard.
ch7.tip1Content: We encourage all customers to inspect the outer packaging of valuable items (electronics, fragile goods) in the presence of branch operators before leaving the office.
ch7.tip2Content: AmTrans provides standard free storage at destination offices for up to 14 calendar days from the date of the READY notification.

UNDER_REVIEW.label: Under Review
UNDER_REVIEW.description: Order details submitted and undergoing automated or operator checks.

PENDING_ESTIMATE.label: Pending Estimate
PENDING_ESTIMATE.description: Custom route without automated tariff; awaiting operator price quote.

REGISTERED.label: Registered
REGISTERED.description: Order confirmed and ready for merchant package delivery to overseas hub.

FOREIGN_WAREHOUSE.label: Foreign Warehouse
FOREIGN_WAREHOUSE.description: Arrived at international warehouse (Dubai/US/China), weighed, and logged.

IN_TRANSIT.label: In Transit
IN_TRANSIT.description: En route aboard cargo aircraft or cross-border transport toward Armenia.

ARRIVED.label: Arrived
ARRIVED.description: Landed in Armenia and sorting through regional customs processing.

READY.label: Ready for Pickup
READY.description: Processed at local AmTrans branch and ready for customer handover.

DELIVERED.label: Delivered
DELIVERED.description: Package successfully collected by customer or authorized receiver.

REJECTED.label: Rejected
REJECTED.description: Shipment rejected due to prohibited items or customs compliance issues.

CANCELLED.label: Cancelled
CANCELLED.description: Order cancelled upon customer request or price estimate decline.

404.title: Page Not Found
404.description: The page you are looking for might have been moved, deleted, or does not exist. Please check the URL or return home.

generic.title: Something Went Wrong
generic.description: An unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Please try again or return home.
